do.name: Old town canals and Palais de l'Isle
do.detail: Arcaded lanes and flower-lined canals around the 12th century island prison, with the castle terrace above the roofs.

do.name: Cycle the lake greenway
do.detail: A car-free voie verte rings the lake for about 40 km of shoreline riding; rental bikes and swim stops make it an easy day.

do.name: Swim in Lake Annecy
do.detail: Turquoise alpine water warm enough for summer swims; free public beaches dot the shore alongside a few paid lidos.

do.name: Paraglide from Col de la Forclaz
do.detail: One of the world's top free-flight sites; tandem flights launch from the col and drift down over the turquoise lake.

do.name: Annecy International Animation Film Festival
do.detail: The world's biggest animation festival takes over town for a June week: screenings, open-air projections and industry crowds.

do.name: Balcony hikes: Semnoz and La Tournette
do.detail: Trails above the lake run from easy Semnoz forest paths to the 2,351 m La Tournette climb, all with big lake views.

do.name: Fete du Lac fireworks
do.detail: First weekend of August the bay becomes a stage for one of Europe's great pyrotechnic shows, drawing 100,000 plus.
